M. Murugappa Chettiar.{{cite news |title=Forbes article on Murugappa Group|url= https://www.forbes.com/global/2011/1107/india-billionaires-11-murugappa-vellayan-old-bold-raghunathan.html | first=Anuradha | last=Raghunathan}}{{cite news |title=Murugappa group posts 18% growth in its profit to Rs 2,880 crore|url= https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/murugappa-group-posts-18-growth-in-its-profit-to-rs-2880-crore/1579478/ | date=2019-07-02}} The Group has 29 businesses including 10 companies listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]].{{cite news |title=Forbes India's Richest 2023|url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/murugappa-family/ }} Headquartered in [[Chennai]], the major companies of the Group include [[Carborundum Universal]], Cholamandalam Financial Holdings, [[Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company|Cholamandalam Investment and Finance]], [[Cholamandalam MS General Insurance]], [[Coromandel International]], [[EID Parry]], Parry Agro Industries, Shanthi Gears, [[Tube Investments of India Limited|Tube Investments of India]], Wendt (India), and [[CG Power and Industrial Solutions]]. In 2024, their net worth was estimated as [[Indian rupee|₹]]85,000 [[crore]] (₹{{crore|85000}}, or about US$9.8 billion). The Group has presence in several segments including [[abrasives]], auto components, [[bicycle]]s, [[sugar]], farm inputs, [[fertiliser]]s, [[plantation]]s, [[bioproducts]] and [[nutraceutical]]s. It owns brands like BSA, Hercules, Montra, Montra Electric, Mach City, Ballmaster, Ajax, Parry's, Chola, Gromor, Shanthi Gears and Paramfos. The group has a workforce of over 60,000 employees.{{Cite news|url=https://www.murugappa.com/about-us/|title=Conglomerates in India {{!}} Murugappa Group {{!}} Business Groups|date=2015-10-14|access-date=2019-06-02|language=en-US}} The current executive chairman is MM Murugappan.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/murugappa-group-appoints-mm-murugappan-as-executive-chairman/articleshow/62792748.cms|title=Murugappa Group appoints MM Murugappan as executive chairman|last=Chandrashekhar|first=Anandi|date=2018-02-05|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2018-03-26}} ==The Group & family == ===Murugappa Chettiar Family=== * [[Murugappa family]] * Founder: :* Dewan Bahadur A. Murugappa Group is an Indian conglomerate founded in 1900 by A. M. Murugappa Chettiar. The Group has 29 businesses including 10 companies listed on the NSE and the BSE. Headquartered in Chennai, the major companies of the Group include Carborundum Universal, Cholamandalam Financial Holdings, Cholamandalam Investment and Finance, Cholamandalam MS General Insurance, Coromandel International, EID Parry, Parry Agro Industries, Shanthi Gears, Tube Investments of India, Wendt (India), and CG Power and Industrial Solutions. In 2024, their net worth was estimated as ₹85,000 crore (₹850,000,000,000, or about US$9.8 billion).
The Group has presence in several segments including abrasives, auto components, bicycles, sugar, farm inputs, fertilisers, plantations, bioproducts and nutraceuticals. It owns brands like BSA, Hercules, Montra, Montra Electric, Mach City, Ballmaster, Ajax, Parry's, Chola, Gromor, Shanthi Gears and Paramfos. The group has a workforce of over 60,000 employees. The current executive chairman is MM Murugappan.
